description: Five-panel composite figure of dilatometric bainitic-transformation kinetics for low-density Al–C steels, every panel plotting relative length change RLC (%) (y-axis 0.00–0.30) against time (s). (a) and (b) use logarithmic time axes; (c)–(e) replot the same data on linear time axes. (a) (log 10^0–10^5 s) overlays six curves for Al ≥ 6 wt.%: S1 - T_B: 300 °C (black), S1 - T_B: 350 °C (red), S2 - T_B: 300 °C (blue), S2 - T_B: 350 °C (green), S3 - T_B: 270 °C (purple) and S3 - T_B: 350 °C (orange); the purple S3-270 °C curve is by far the slowest. (b) (log 10^0–10^4 s) shows five curves for Al < 6 wt.%: S4 - T_B (T_A: 1150 °C): 300 °C (black), S4 - T_B (T_A: 1150 °C): 350 °C (red), S4 - T_B (T_A: 1250 °C): 350 °C (blue), S5 - T_B: 335 °C (green), S5 - T_B: 365 °C (purple). (c) is a linear-time view (0–4500 s) of four S1/S2 curves with vertical dashed lines Bt = 1600 s (red), 2300 s (green), 3600 s (blue), 4000 s (black). (d) isolates the slow S3 curves: orange Bt = 14000 s and purple Bt = 43000 s on a 0–50000 s axis. (e) (0–4000 s) shows the S4/S5 curves with Bt = 700 s, 1000 s, 2600 s, 3000 s and 3500 s. The group demonstrates that higher Al content and lower austempering temperature strongly retard bainite completion, while S4/S5 transform orders of magnitude faster than S3.

observations.observation: All five panels share the same y-axis quantity and scale: relative length change RLC (%), from 0.00 to 0.30, and no curve exceeds 0.30%.
Panel (a) has a logarithmic time axis spanning 10^0 to 10^5 s; panel (b) has a logarithmic time axis spanning 10^0 to 10^4 s.
The legend of (a) lists six conditions: S1 - T_B: 300 °C (black), S1 - T_B: 350 °C (red), S2 - T_B: 300 °C (blue), S2 - T_B: 350 °C (green), S3 - T_B: 270 °C (purple), S3 - T_B: 350 °C (orange).
In (a) the purple S3 - T_B: 270 °C curve is displaced to the longest times, reaching about 0.28% RLC near 5×10^4 s, whereas the red S1 - T_B: 350 °C curve departs from the baseline just above 10^2 s.

The legend of (b) lists five conditions including the austenitizing temperature: S4 - T_B (T_A: 1150 °C): 300 °C, S4 - T_B (T_A: 1150 °C): 350 °C, S4 - T_B (T_A: 1250 °C): 350 °C, S5 - T_B: 335 °C and S5 - T_B: 365 °C.
In (b) all five curves begin transforming near 10^1 s, i.e. an order of magnitude earlier than in (a).
Panel (c) prints vertical dashed lines labelled Bt = 1600 s (red), Bt = 2300 s (green), Bt = 3600 s (blue) and Bt = 4000 s (black) on a linear axis running to 4500 s.
Panel (d) prints Bt = 14000 s (orange, S3 - T_B: 350 °C) and Bt = 43000 s (purple, S3 - T_B: 270 °C), with the time axis extending to 50000 s.
Panel (e) prints Bt = 700 s (green), Bt = 1000 s (purple), Bt = 2600 s (blue), Bt = 3000 s (red) and Bt = 3500 s (black) on a 0–4000 s linear axis.

The caption states that panels (a–b) use a logarithmic time axis while (c–e) replot the same data on a linear time axis for readability, and that the vertical dashed lines mark the approximate bainite finish time for each condition.
The caption states (c) is a linear-time view of panel (a) for S1 and S2 and (d) is a linear-time view isolating the slowest transformation from panel (a), S3, over an extended time.

The citing text states bainitic transformation behaviour was evaluated from the dilatometric RLC (%)–time (s) curves summarised in Fig. 6 (a) and (b), with S1–S3 for Al ≥ 6 wt.% and S4–S5 for Al < 6 wt.%.

The citing text asserts that TiMoC precipitates accelerate bainite nucleation in S4 giving a shorter incubation time than S1, S2 and S3, but that impingement of bainite sheaves suppresses the later progression of transformation in S4 relative to S1 and S2 (see Fig. 6).

The caption's statement that (c) is a view of S1 and S2 is consistent with four dashed Bt lines in (c) (S1-300, S1-350, S2-300, S2-350), but the individual curves in (c) are identified only by colour, not by in-panel text labels.

subfigures.description: Dilatometry RLC (%) vs time (log axis 10^0–10^5 s) for Al ≥ 6 wt.% steels, six curves in legend S1 - T_B: 300 °C (black), S1 - T_B: 350 °C (red), S2 - T_B: 300 °C (blue), S2 - T_B: 350 °C (green), S3 - T_B: 270 °C (purple), S3 - T_B: 350 °C (orange). The purple S3-270 °C curve is shifted to the longest times (rising near 10^3–10^4 s and reaching ~0.28% near 5×10^4 s); the red S1-350 °C curve starts rising earliest, just above 10^2 s.

Dilatometry RLC (%) vs time (log axis 10^0–10^4 s) for Al < 6 wt.% steels, five curves: S4 - T_B (T_A: 1150 °C): 300 °C (black), S4 - T_B (T_A: 1150 °C): 350 °C (red), S4 - T_B (T_A: 1250 °C): 350 °C (blue), S5 - T_B: 335 °C (green), S5 - T_B: 365 °C (purple). All curves begin near 10^1 s; the green S5-335 °C curve saturates highest (~0.27%) while the blue S4-1250 °C-350 °C curve stays lowest (~0.16%).

Linear-time view (0–4500 s) of the S1/S2 curves from (a): red, blue, green and black curves rising from ~0 at 100–200 s. Vertical dashed lines labelled Bt = 1600 s (red), Bt = 2300 s (green), Bt = 3600 s (blue) and Bt = 4000 s (black) mark bainite finish times. Blue reaches the highest RLC (~0.275), black the lowest (~0.25).

Extended linear-time view (0–50000 s) isolating the two slow S3 curves from (a): purple (S3 - T_B: 270 °C), which rises to ~0.29% with Bt = 43000 s, and orange (S3 - T_B: 350 °C), which plateaus near 0.09% with Bt = 14000 s. Dashed vertical lines and rotated text labels give both Bt values.

Linear-time view (0–4000 s) of the S4/S5 curves from (b): green (S5 - 335 °C) rising fastest and reaching ~0.27%, purple (S5 - 365 °C) ~0.22%, red and black S4 curves ~0.25%, blue (S4 - 1250 °C - 350 °C) lowest at ~0.16%. Vertical dashed lines labelled Bt = 700 s (green), Bt = 1000 s (purple), Bt = 2600 s (blue), Bt = 3000 s (red) and Bt = 3500 s (black).

unreadable_items: panels (c) and (d): no in-panel colour legend, so individual curves in the linear-time views must be matched to (a)/(b) by colour alone
top edge of panels (c) and (d) shows a partially cropped neighbouring panel label (rendered as fragments 'b)' / 'a)'), which is a layout artefact rather than figure content
